items.title: ASEAN leaders, 8 dialogue partners commit to UNCLOS
items.description: Leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations and eight dialogue-partners adopted last night a joint declaration of their strong commitment to international law, particularly the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

items.title: Lacson questions VP camp’s ‘honest mistake’ claim
items.description: Sen. Panfilo Lacson yesterday cast doubt that Vice President made an “honest mistake” in declaring shares in GenCorp Industries in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth.

items.title: Panelo links threats to VP’s ex-staff to government
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp believes that the alleged threats made against a former member of her household staff could be linked to the Marcos administration.

items.title: Major issues on Code of Conduct settled – Marcos
items.description: Although a binding code of conduct for South China Sea claimants was not completed under the Philippines’ chairship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, President Marcos said the major issues surrounding the proposed rules have been settled.

items.title: China to ASEAN: Promote peace, trust despite tensions
items.description: Pointing out that “flame runs high when everyone adds wood to the fire,” a ranking Chinese official yesterday called on the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to promote peace and mutual trust as tensions over the the South China Sea simmer.

items.title: Japan PM wants Asia oil security task force created
items.description: Japan proposed yesterday the creation of the Asia oil security task force that would coordinate cooperation on oil stockpiling and release of supplies during emergencies as countries seek to mitigate the impacts of oil supply disruptions stemming from the Middle East crisis.

items.title: BINI, SB19 earn first Grammy nods
items.description: P-pop groups BINI and SB19 earned their first Grammy nominations, while Filipino-American artists Bruno Mars and Olivia Rodrigo bagged nods in the top categories of the 2027 Grammy Awards.

items.title: Marcos hails ‘successful’ Philippines chairship of ASEAN
items.description: President Marcos turned over the chairship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and described the Philippines’ hosting of the bi-annual meeting of the 11-member regional bloc as “successful.”

items.title: Charges loom for 114 erring gas stations
items.description: The Department of Energy is preparing to take legal action against 114 gas stations that failed to comply with last week’s major fuel price rollback.

items.title: Quad vows to ensure open maritime corridors
items.description: Leaders of Australia, India, Japan and the United States criticized what they described as “destabilizing or unilateral actions” affecting regional peace and stability, in a meeting held on the sidelines of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit in Manila.
